name: Gold
note: Not on the US list; on China's strategic list. Included as context for Chinese mining presence (Zijin in Suriname, Colombia, Guyana; Arco Minero in Venezuela).
uses: Jewellery, investment and central-bank reserves, electronics.
why_it_matters: Not on the US critical list, but on China's strategic list; gold is the largest mineral export of several countries and the commodity behind much Chinese mining presence (Suriname, Colombia, Guyana, Venezuela), so it is kept as context, not as a critical mineral.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures

hs_codes.description: Precious-metal ores and concentrates, other than silver
